messages:
emma (oncall): getting multiple missed pages from prod-2 this morning. alert fired at 07:18 but incident-bot didn't escalate to rota. anyone seen this?

raj (eng-sre): seeing it too. pd webhook shows delivery at 07:18, but notify-broker logs look weird — seems to accept then drop. grabbing logs now.

devops-bot: [system] POST /hooks/pager -> 200 OK, x-ttl: 0, delivered_to: notify-broker-3, result: suppressed_by_ttl_check

raj (eng-sre): log snippet:```
2025-07-27T07:18:12.345Z notify-broker INFO incoming webhook id=ab12 ttl="0"
2025-07-27T07:18:12.346Z notify-broker WARN ttl_mismatch: header=30 payload.ttl=0 route=prod-rotas
2025-07-27T07:18:12.347Z notify-broker ERROR drop event id=ab12 reason=ttl_mismatch
```

tyler (infra): we rotated routing tokens last night. wondering if header parsing changed during that deploy. looking at token-rotation PR now.

maria (support): customers are hitting degraded responses too. ticket INC-1234 opened — they saw retries and delayed fallbacks between 07:18-07:44. asked them for exact request ids.

emma (oncall): ok manual escalation done (phone). but we need pages restored asap — oncall missed initial pager. @tyler can we hotfix notify-broker to accept the legacy TTL shape?

raj (eng-sre): quick mitigation: re-enable legacy-ttl-check fallback. editing /etc/notify-broker/conf: set `accept_zero_ttl = true` and restart. will patch now.

carol (incident-bot): Incidentbot: failed to enqueue page id=ab12 err=ttl_mismatch route=prod-rotas attempt=1 backoff=30s

tyler (infra): applying patch:```sudo vi /etc/notify-broker/conf
# temporarily allow legacy payloads
accept_zero_ttl = true
systemctl restart notify-broker.service
```restarting on prod-2...

devops-bot: deploy log: notify-broker restart triggered at 2025-07-27T07:26:50Z on prod-2 by tyler. healthcheck: ok.

raj (eng-sre): tail shows pages being enqueued again:```
2025-07-27T07:27:05.112Z notify-broker INFO enqueue page id=ab13 route=prod-rotas status=enqueued
2025-07-27T07:27:05.130Z incident-queue INFO dispatched page id=ab13 to pagerduty
```

maria (support): confirmed with customer that they got a page at 07:27 and are receiving alerts again. I'll update INC-1234.

emma (oncall): thanks. next steps: add an uptime alert when incident-bot doesn't deliver ack to oncall within 2m and add this scenario to runbook. :eyes: :+1: 

raj (eng-sre): creating PR for runbook and test: add integration test that simulates TTL header formats (int,string,empty) and confirm notify-broker accepts valid pages. linking issue INF-998.

tyler (infra): root cause summary for postmortem: token-rotation service changed header serialization for `X-Request-TTL` from integer->string in the header when rotating tokens; notify-broker's strict TTL check treated stringified-zero as 0 and suppressed. fix: make parser tolerant (int or string), add unit + integration tests, and remove accept_zero_ttl fallback after validated deploy.

carol (incident-bot): auto-summary: missed pages window 07:18-07:26 (approx 8 pages). manual escalation performed. tags: paging, notify-broker, token-rotation, ttl-parsing.

emma (oncall): will run postmortem checklist, mark SEV-LOW and assign owners. thanks all for quick turn.

maria (support): I'll leave a note in the customer ticket about mitigation and follow-up.

raj (eng-sre): PR opened for parser fix + tests, will schedule canary deploy to prod-2 tomorrow 06:00 UTC.

tyler (infra): once canary passes we'll remove the `accept_zero_ttl` temporary flag. closing loop on infra changes.

emma (oncall): closing thread — pages restored and customers notified.
